reviews.author: Nyantami
reviews.text: Hands down one of the best printing companies to work with, really professional and fast output, down to earth people that I highly recommend and their prices are honestly one of the most reasonable and the quality is still very good!!! will definitely be their regular ☺️

reviews.author: JIM NG GHIM HUNG
reviews.text: Great service and very professional, Owen is the person to go to, he's very experienced and resourceful

reviews.author: Mihika Joshi
reviews.text: Really good service. Owen helped me out with my shirts and was available around the clock. He even helped me improve the quality of my images that were originally not very good.

reviews.author: Serena Wee
reviews.text: Good for school jackets and managed to find a affordable and low quality supplier so that we can order for our cca members! customer service is great too

reviews.author: Tien Dat Nguyen
reviews.text: Wonderful experience, Owen has been very communicative, responsive and helpful and delivery was way ahead of schedule even though we ordered the shirts last minute in a tight deadline. Shirt quality is excellent and turned out exactly as we hoped for. Price is also very reasonable and much better compared to other supplier. We will definitely work with mysourceofsolutions again in the future. Thank you so much Owen and team!
